expected_outcomes: Commits are reviewable, truthful, scoped, and explain intent.
required_actions: Use Conventional Commits with a clear type, scope, and present-tense description.
acceptance: Commits contain no unrelated changes and messages describe intent.
verification: Inspect staged diff and resulting commit.
failure_conditions: A commit mixes concerns, misstates behavior, or obscures intent.
exceptions: Record why an automated mechanical commit needs a different scope.
